review_evidence: README identifies verified rendering of the Mandelbrot set and its potential function, built on verified interval arithmetic and formal holomorphic dynamics.
Correct/Area.lean proves correctness of free-radius bounds, conservative upper bounds for Mandelbrot area on squares and globally, symmetry, and measurability facts used by the renderer.
Render and Correct modules contain numerous proof-backed numerical and analytic results; this is substantive verified-computation prior art.
summary: Retain ray-render as verified Mandelbrot rendering and area-estimation code with substantive analytic and numerical correctness proofs.
